title: Nightcord at 25:00 Chapter1 Episode11 The Missing Sound

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: No... This doesn't sound right at all.
But it wasn't enough. I wasn't able to find anything.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, K. I was thinking about this for just before the chorus. What do you think?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah, I was wondering what we should do with the part before the chorus. Did you see the file I sent?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <You okay? You sound a little out of it. Did you get enough sleep?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Hey, K. Maybe you should take a break.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <So, who's writing the lyrics for the next song?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <It doesn't look like Yuki is coming back. So I figure we should probably make a decision soon.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Not just the lyrics.
I'll do Yuki's part and take care of the arrangement and the mixing as well.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <That's a little much, don't you think? Composing the music is hard enough by itself. Maybe we should find a replacement for Yuki.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I have to keep making more songs.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <We're not trying to get in anyone's way...?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I don't think she's even listening any more.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Talking about this now isn't going to get us anywhere. Let's leave it for later.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(No, the guitar tone is too thin here.
But it needs to sound subtle.)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
(Huh? What's going on?
I'm starting to feel dizzy even though I'm sitting down...)

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, right. I haven't eaten since yesterday.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: But I don't have time for that.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? A new song from OWN?

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: (It feels like being at the bottom of a black ocean, devoid of all light...)
K, the first time I heard your songs, I felt like they had saved me. A little bit.
But it wasn't enough. I wasn't able to find anything.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I guess in the end, she only thought she'd been saved.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: And assuming I'd been able to save Yuki with my music made me feel as if I'd been saved too.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
Even so, I have to keep going.
If I can't write songs that are able to save somebody, then I...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Is there really any reason for me to keep going?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: You have such a gift, Kanade.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: You've really been blessed by music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Kanade, make sure you keep creating your own music.

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: I don't think I can keep going...

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Kanade
rows.Line: Dad, this is my song! I made it on the computer!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: All by yourself? That's amazing! Can I hear it?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: It's wonderful. I didn't realize you could write such gentle songs. I'm sure your mother would have loved it, too.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Kanade
rows.Line: You think so? I'm so glad! I want to make songs like yours, so I worked really hard on it!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Kanade
rows.Line:
Yeah! Mom really loved your music.
She always looked happy listening to your songs.

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Kanade
rows.Line: That's why I want to write songs that make people happy just like you do.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I see. It makes me happy to hear that. I'll have to work even harder to write more songs that will make people happy too, then!

rows.Speaker: Elementary School Kanade
rows.Line: I'll make sure to work really hard so I can be as good of a song writer as you when I grow up!

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I see. Yes. Something more suited to today's music?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I understand. Thank you for the feedback. Okay, goodbye.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Dad, dinner is ready. Are you okay?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Hm? Oh, Kanade. It's already time for dinner?

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Yeah. You're always eating instant noodles for lunch, so you should at least have a decent meal for dinner.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: I messed up the cooking again, though, so today's just some instant curry and something to go with it from the store.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: That's more than enough, Kanade, thanks. Dad's got to eat if he's going to keep working hard.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: I'd really like to enter this next song into a competition for a commercial spot. This could be my big break as a composer.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line:
That sounds great. I'll be cheering for you.
Eat up so you can work hard, then.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line:
Why can't I think of anything?
It just needs a little something more.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Sorry, Kanade. Go ahead and start without me.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Hey, Dad? Would it be okay if I listened to your song?

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: Huh? Oh, sure. Just for a minute.

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Is this the part you're having trouble with? What if you...

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line:
Oh, sorry.
It just sort of popped into my head. It's probably not very good.

rows.Speaker: Kanade's Father
rows.Line: That's not true. This is great, Kanade. But what made you think to change it like this?

rows.Speaker: Young Kanade
rows.Line: Huh? I just thought it might work a little better this way.
